card.fact_statement: On 3 August 2024, coordinators of the Students Against Discrimination announced a one-point demand for the resignation of the Prime Minister.
card.source_span: On 3 August 2024, coordinators of the Students Against Discrimination announced a one-point demand for the resignation of the Prime Minister and her cabinet

target_qa_variants.question: 「差別反対学生運動」のコーディネーターが、首相の辞任を求める1項目の要求を発表したのは何年何月何日ですか？
target_qa_variants.source_span: On 3 August 2024, coordinators of the Students Against Discrimination announced a one-point demand for the resignation of the Prime Minister and her cabinet
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Students Against Discrimination translated as 差別反対学生運動. 'one-point demand' translated as 1項目の要求.

backtranslation_en.question: On what date did the coordinators of the 'Anti-Discrimination Student Movement' announce a one-point demand calling for the resignation of the Prime Minister?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The target language QA accurately translates the source question and expected answer, preserving the exact fact and intent without adding new constraints.
